what: Why the 2026-08-17 Fig. 4 y-axis is not the Paper number
defect: single 2 cm axial rotation at mid-scan
why_not_exam_dose: The reconstructed series is 15–40 cm long. Organ mean dose from one 2 cm rotation is the overlap of that beam with the organ mask, not the helical-exam absorbed dose. Scaling to CTDIvol does not undo the dilution.

evidence.literature_order: abdominal organ dose / CTDIvol is order 1, not 0.03

fix: Contiguous axial stations covering the reconstructed length, same collimation as the bowtie-aware CTDI scale. TCM I(z) weights each station. Stations are summed. tools/run_patient.py + axial_station_z_cm.
ctdi_scale: The 7-run bowtie-aware CTDIw_MC remains valid (one rotation is the CTDI definition). Do not re-run it.
not: Not a reason to drop N=32, alias scanners, coarsen spectra, or send the PMB inquiry on the mid-scan scatter.
